suggestions.reason: The alert describes funds returning to the origin account.
Circular flows often involve rapid movement of funds between related accounts.
Many small transfers just under a reporting threshold would point to splitting amounts.
Account activity logs would show how the five accounts behave over time.
Cross-border routing records would show convoluted paths.
